quirks.description: Opt-in quirks the workflow selected (`generic/patterns/quirks/`); each module checks its own value.

dark_pages.description: A page whose rules print paler than the rest of the document takes its own gray level (physical page → level): a level the whole document takes would read the pale strokes of other pages as rules (千代田区 R5 決算の歳入 p45, its column rules at gray 223).

skewed.description: A scan set a little off level breaks each long horizontal rule into pieces a pixel row apart (国分寺市): the pieces are joined end to end before a rule's length is checked, and the words of one printed line are grouped with a wider tolerance (a line's amount at the right end sits up to 2.5pt above its name at the left).

skewed_columns.description: A scan turned enough that a column rule steps a pixel column every few points (131113 R5 決算) breaks each column rule into pieces too short for the detector over a header's short cells: the pieces of a vertical rule are joined end to end before its length is checked, as `skewed` does for the horizontal ones.

spread_rows.description: Each scanned page is a spread of two pages side by side (131113 R5 決算, A3): a row rule drawn across one column group of one page (the 節 rows under 区分・金額) is kept at a third of the share of the width a row rule is kept at on a single page (120pt of a 1190pt sheet).

row_gaps.description: A vertical rule the page leaves out for a row lets the row's text run on into the next column (133086's 事業 names): an OCR line is cut only at the rules drawn across its middle.

line_pieces.description: With `row_gaps`, a Paddle line is also cut into its characters' pieces only at the rules drawn across its middle, not at every rule of the page (131199 決算 歳入: the rules of the 説明 table printed lower in the 当初予算額 column split the amount of the 款 row above it, `12,694,927` | `,000`).

short_columns.description: A column rule drawn only over one short row (shorter than the page-wide detector keeps) is still a rule: a short vertical stroke joining two horizontal rules at the place of a vertical rule the page draws elsewhere closes the cell, as in a staircase (131199's 目 rows between 事務事業 blocks).

row_columns.description: A narrow stroke that runs the whole height between two horizontal rules is a column rule even where the page draws no rule at that place elsewhere (131164's 財源 columns under 説明, drawn only over a 目's row in the middle of a page).

within.description: The heading printed over this column only on the other page of the spread (北区の予算説明書の歳入: `節` over `区分` on the left page, the `金額` of the 節 alone on the right): the column's heading path starts with it.

lines.description: One cell stacks the item's amounts a line each, the later ones in brackets (国分寺市: `1,147,465` / `(1,110,941)` / `(36,524)` under `本年度 (前年度) (比較)`): the heading of each line, top to bottom.

line_pitch.description: The distance in points from one stacked line (`lines`) to the next, where the lines stand further apart than their height (国立市: 10pt figures 14pt apart). Without it a line is taken to be .82 of the name's height below the one above.

excluded.description: The column is not taken in: the builder reads none of it, and its printed digits are a coverage exclusion of the whole column on every page, with a kind of the shared vocabulary and the reason.

overhang.description: Points the text layer sets the column's digits past its right rule (a font the PDF does not embed, 小笠原村): they are still the column's.

frame_headings.description: One page prints several tables, each under headings printed above its frame (栃木県の公営企業の予算実施計画: 収益的収入及び支出 / 資本的収入及び支出, then 収入 / 支出). `levels`: the headings of each level, a heading clearing the levels below it; a frame keeps the headings read above it, on its page or the pages before. Only the frames whose headings are `keep` (one per level) are read; the others are another table's (別の表).

open_frame.description: No rule closes the table at its top or foot, and the 款・項 columns rule only the rows that open a 款・項 (八丈町 R6): a column counts with one row rule, and the frame runs from where its side rules start to where they end.

section.description: The layout pattern `titled_table`: the table among others on the same pages that is printed under `title` (小笠原村 R5 決算の `表15`); `continued` are the pages that go on with it and print no title.

carried.description: Only the first page of a run prints the column headings (八丈町 R6): a frame drawn with the same column rules as a frame read before it, whose top prints fewer than half of its heading words, takes its headings and is body from its top rule.

staircase.description: The subject columns are a staircase: one header cell 款 項 目 over narrow code columns, and the 款・項 cells run down the page with no closing rule. "款項目節" also reads a header cell 款 項 目 節 over four columns, the fourth being 節. "款項目名" reads a header cell 款 項 目 over four columns, the fourth being the names of every level (神戸市).

agree_on_bottom.description: Scan: the agreed header reading is moved onto each page aligned on the header's bottom rule, not the frame's top (a frame boxing the page title above the header on some pages).

merged_cells.description: Header cells (`説明`) whose columns are ruled only in some rows: in a row their rules leave out, one cell runs across them and its words are read as one column under the header cell.

unagreed.description: Scan: each page keeps the header it read, and no reading is agreed across pages (the layout draws the header again from the column rules: `redrawn_headers`).

agree_all_frames.description: Scan: every frame of a spread (not only the widest) takes the header reading most pages share, frame by frame from the left.

kind_by_characters.description: A stacked kind under its group whose two printed lines the text layer or OCR read across (翌年度繰越額／継逓繰続費次越) is the known kind its characters spell, not the group (headers.canonical).

facing_pages.description: The layout pattern `running_titles`: a page without a subject column is the right half of the spread opened by the page before it with one, whatever horizontal rules each prints (東久留米市: the left page rules each 目, the right page each line of the 説明).

opening.description: The layout pattern `running_titles` with `carried_names`: a volume that begins inside a 目 repeats it first (`15515(高齢者福祉費)`); the 款・項・目 its codes are, with the names the volume before prints, open the volume as titles.

carried_names.description: The layout patterns `running_titles` and `continued_pages` (there only the subject's own amount columns price the row, and the name may wrap over more lines, 日の出町): the first line of a page's subject column that only repeats the open 目, its codes and its name in brackets with no amount in its row (`10 5 40 (企画調整費)`, 調布市), opens no item.

volume_titles.description: The layout pattern `running_titles` with `title_amount`, where an account is printed in volumes cut inside a 款 and joined by `continued_rows` (文京区 R5): a 款・項 title keeps its amount though the volume does not hold the 款・項 whole; the volume's own difference is declared in `source_inconsistencies`, and dbt checks the amount against the children of all volumes.

revenue_columns.description: The layout pattern `redrawn_headers` on the revenue's facing pages (新宿区の予算事項別明細書の歳入): the left page prints 目・本年度予算額・前年度予算額・比較増(△)減 with no 財源内訳, the right page the 節 and a narrower 説明.

title_amount.description: The heading of the amount a 款・項 title prints with no heading over it (`1款 総務費 24,930,655千円`, the layout pattern `stacked_titles`). The layout pattern `running_titles` also takes a list: the headings of all the amounts the title prints, in their order (`１項 特別区民税 74,027,879 71,639,597 2,388,282`, 杉並区の歳入).

explanations.description: How the layout pattern `explained_subjects` reads the explanation of each 目 printed after its table (神戸市の局別の予算説明書).

heading.description: A heading line of a 目's explanation (matched against the line without spaces, NFKC): its named group `code` is the 目's code, and `name`, when it has one, the 目's name (with no `code`, the 目 is found by its name). None: each table is a card of one 目, explained by the lines under it.

item.description: The start of an item line. The lines of an explanation before its first item say what the 目 is for.

skip.description: A line of an explanation that is a note, no item (`（別途 令和８年２月補正予算 1,297,400千円）`).

character_map.description: Explicit Unicode mapping for broken font maps, before XML parsing and glyph reconstruction. U+FFFD is the glyph Poppler could not map (栃木県 R4 の特別会計: an invisible mark after each header word); mapped to an empty string, a character is dropped. A character of CJK Extension A (U+3400–U+4DBF) is mapped too: a font that maps digits to unrelated ideographs (131156 R5 決算書: `0`–`9` to U+3EDC–U+3EE5, `,` to U+3ED8).

form_clips.description: Text drawn inside a form has its clip in the form's space: an object whose own bounds meet it is visible.

image_rules.description: A page that draws no vector rule has its ruled grid in a background image, or draws it in a pale colour the vector reading takes for no ink (131164's 歳入): the rules are read from the render, as a scan's are, at the gray level `rules.dark` when it is declared.

polyline_rules.description: A frame closed by a path of straight segments instead of lines (131105's 歳入: the bottom of each page's frame): the path's horizontal and vertical segments are rules too.

crop_box.description: Each page shows one half of a sheet printed two pages up through its CropBox (131211): the words and rules outside it are the other page's, observed as that page.

quirks.description: Opt-in quirks the workflow selected (`generic/patterns/quirks/`); each module checks its own value.

name_start_slack.description: Points past the usual 3 a wrapped line may stand from the name's start, where a long number and the blank after it are not as wide as the estimate.

yen_notes.description: With `yen_marked`: a line whose amounts are all in yen (`議長 1人 1,012,000円`, the rates under 議員報酬) is a note of kind 積算 on the item above it, and is no item summed with the column's 千円.

yen_marked.description: An amount that prints 円 after it in a column of another unit is in yen: a reckoning (`46.4円 × 1,115,000件 ＝ 51,736,000円`) set among the column's 千円.
